title: Product hero with cascading key callouts
summary: A flat hardware hero scales up from small and fades in on white, settles, then four thin leader-line callouts with short labels and outlined targets appear one after another. A quiet spec-sheet beat that points at details.
use_when: A hardware or device product where specific buttons, ports or keys deserve a name
A spec-sheet beat inside a longer launch film, after the hero shot
A silent loop for a product page that labels 3-5 details
Clean light keynote look with no camera moves or cuts

look.type_style: small grotesk, medium weight, sentence case, normal tracking, labels about 2.5 % of frame height, dark teal

sfx.event: hero object settles after the scale-in
each callout label and outline land

structure.shot: empty white frame, then the product (flat top view, mint body, white keys) appears centred and grows to ~80 % of frame width
structure.camera: static frame; the hero object scales 0.55 -> 1.00 of its final width (motion.json: 37 %/s zoom in second 0)
structure.motion: opacity 0 -> 1 over 10 fr (f1-f11); scale springs.heavy ~25 fr, settled by f25-f29, no overshoot seen on the 30 fps strip; hold from f30

structure.shot: four callouts cascade: one below the bottom-left key, then three above adjacent top-row keys, each a thin vertical leader, a 1-3 word label and a dark outline on the key
structure.camera: static (hero holds at 1.00, no scale or position change between cells)
structure.motion: callout starts f38, f56, f63, f68 (gaps 18, 7, 5 fr); each: leader draws and label fades in easings.outQuint ~6 fr, key outline appears ~2 fr after the label starts; all settled by f75

structure.shot: full spec frame holds: product with four outlined keys and their labels, nothing moves
structure.motion: hold 45 fr (f75-f120), no motion; end on the full state

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the backdrop, fg/muted for labels and leaders, accent for the target outlines
params.content.product: cut-out product image (top view, transparent background), fills ~80 % of frame width
params.content.callouts: 3-5 items: {label (1-3 words), target rect on the product image, side 'above'|'below'}
params.timing.enter: frames of the hero scale-in (default 25 at 30 fps)
params.timing.stagger: frames between callouts after the first (default 6; the first gap is 18)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; product width caps at 80 % of frame width
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips: hero visible from f1, opaque by f11, settled ~f25-f29 (scale 0.55 -> 1.00, no overshoot). Callouts at f38, f56, f63, f68, all settled by f75; first gap 18 fr, then 5-7 fr. One shot, no cuts, silent. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary, not used as ids): hero-scale-in, spec-callout. The 4.00 s single shot was split at visible state changes (f38, f75). Flat 2D product image, no 3D despite the family.
